features.name: LLM-based app translation using Claude
features.description: Tool that integrates Claude LLM into the AL Build pipeline to automatically translate Business Central app labels into multiple languages using context from system prompts.
caveats: Requires setting up AL Build tool
Stores translations in local database to avoid repeated LLM calls

features.name: Translation file (XLIFF) support in app.json
features.description: Feature flag called 'translate file' in app.json that enables generation of translation files in XLIFF format containing source text and target translation placeholders.
caveats: Only translatable content must be defined as labels, not strings

features.name: AL Build with translation task
features.description: Python-based AL Build tool that runs translation tasks on XLIFF files, including updating app versions, compiling, and calling LLM translation services with system prompts.
caveats: Multiple tasks in AL Build configuration
Runs sequentially; parallel translation mentioned as not in current version

features.name: Context injection through system prompts
features.description: Ability to provide detailed system prompts to the LLM describing the app purpose, target users, and domain context to improve translation quality and appropriateness.

features.name: Microsoft translation database integration
features.description: Local database that stores approved Microsoft translations for common labels to ensure consistency and reduce wrong translations by reusing Microsoft's localized terminology.
caveats: Only applies to recognized Microsoft labels

features.name: Developer comments for translation guidance
features.description: Developers can add comments to labels that are passed to the LLM to provide additional context or special instructions for how to translate specific text, such as tone or domain-specific guidance.
caveats: Comments were previously unused for translation but now fed to LLM
